description: This file defines a client class for interacting with a chat completion API over HTTP, including methods for generating standard and streaming chat completions, with support for authentication and error handling.

classes.name: ChatClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with a chat completion API, supporting both standard and streaming responses, authentication via API key, and customizable request parameters.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the ChatClient with base URL and optional API key for authentication.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _get_headers(self)
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers, including authorization if API key is provided.

methods.name: Union[Dict[str,Any],requests.Request] completions( self, model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: Optional[float] = None, top_p: Optional[float] = None, n: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens: Optional[int] = None, presence_penalty: Optional[float] = None, frequency_penalty: Optional[float] = None, user: Optional[str] = None, return_request: bool = False, )
methods.description: Creates a chat completion request with optional parameters, returns either response data or a prepared request object.

methods.name: Iterator[Dict[str,Any]] completions_stream( self, model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: Optional[float] = None, top_p: Optional[float] = None, n: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens: Optional[int] = None, presence_penalty: Optional[float] = None, frequency_penalty: Optional[float] = None, user: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat completion, yielding response chunks as they arrive.
